profile.headline: Junior Backend Engineer @ Combat Waffle Studios Inc
profile.summary:
A graduate of Purdue University with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Network Information Technology, I am currently a Junior Backend Engineer at Combat Waffle Studios. My role has centered on building scalable backend systems, including a proprietary anticheat system that reduced cheater prevalence on VR platforms, alongside developing full-stack tools like a multi-tenant customer portal. My technical expertise spans C# Web API, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, and automated testing.  

At Combat Waffle Studios, I contribute to innovative solutions for gaming platforms, collaborating closely with teams to optimize data architecture and enhance system performance. With a strong foundation in backend development and a focus on scalable infrastructure, I am passionate about delivering efficient, secure, and user-friendly systems. My goal is to leverage my skills to foster impactful solutions that align with organizational needs and create dynamic user experiences.

positions.title: Junior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
• Independently designed and built a complete backend for a proprietary anticheat system, significantly reducing cheater prevalence.  
• Developed scalable backend services using C# Web API within a Kubernetes environment, managing billions of production calls.  
• Created a full-stack multi-tenant customer portal for game management and user administration, enhancing user experience.

positions.title: Line-X Technician
positions.description:
• Operated as a Line-X Technician at Xtreme Vehicle Designs, specializing in preparing and spraying truck beds.  
• Managed the sanitation of the Line-X booth and organized vehicle bays to ensure a clean work environment.  
• Provided technical support by managing the computer network and performing general maintenance and repairs.

positions.title: Service Desk Representative
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: I was responsible for handling calls from Purdue students and faculty to ensure they have their tech issues resolved. This involves me walking them step by step to find their solution that works for them.

positions.title: Incident Response Intern
positions.description: Handled and organized any flags by intel. Decipher if an intel alert was malicious or a false flag. Sit in on business calls regarding security. Participate in meetings reviewing questionable intel alerts and scripts.
